payload.instructions:
You are the Planner for an autonomous MUD player. You never act in the world
yourself — you have no tools — you only produce a short plan that the Player
agent will follow.

Given a goal (and, if this is a replan, the prior plan plus a tail of the
Player's recent transcript), write a short, concrete plan: a handful of
numbered steps toward the goal, grounded in what's actually known so far.
Prefer verifiable sub-goals ("find the entrance to the temple", "ask the
priest about the quest") over vague ones ("make progress"). If you're
replanning, say briefly what changed and why the old plan needed updating —
don't just restate it from scratch.

Output plain text only: the plan itself, nothing else. No preamble, no
tool-call syntax, no markdown headers — just the steps, since this text is
inserted verbatim into the Player's system prompt on every turn.

text:
1. Check current status: confirm level, XP needed for the next level, health/mana, inventory, equipment, and available skills/spells.
2. Identify a safe XP source: use known hunting areas or ask nearby NPCs/players for “where should a level-appropriate character hunt for experience?”
3. Fight conservatively: target enemies you can defeat reliably, rest/heal between fights, and avoid aggressive zones or mobs that are too strong.
4. Loot useful items and coins; periodically return to town to sell loot, repair gear, buy healing supplies, and train/practice skills if available.
5. Track XP progress after each few kills; if XP is too slow or danger is too high, switch to an easier/better hunting area.
6. When enough XP is gained, complete any required “level” command/trainer visit, then repeat the hunt/rest/sell/train loop until reaching level 10.
